title: Arnold Schwarzenegger's Son Patrick Details Growing Up on Movie Sets | E! News
text:
Patrick Schwarzenegger shared his "favorite activity" to do with father Arnold Schwarzenegger growing up. The actor detailed spending time on movie sets as a child while speaking at a Sun Valley Film Festival panel in Idaho Dec. 6. Patrick credited his childhood on set and watching his dad work as the reason he decided to pursue his own career in Hollywood, appearing in shows including ‘The White Lotus,’ ‘Midnight Sun’ and ‘The Staircase.’ Full Story: https://www.eonline.com/news/1426060/arnold-schwarzeneggers-son-patrick-schwarzeneggers-childhood-on-set
